title: CAN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS REPLACE HUMANS IN THE SYSTEMATIC REVIEW PROCESS? EVALUATING GPT-4's EFFICACY IN SCREENING AND EXTRACTING DATA FROM PEER-REVIEWED AND GREY LITERATURE IN MULTIPLE LANGUAGES

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing GPT-4's screening and data extraction performance metrics (sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, and Cohen's Kappa) on English documents versus non-English documents (Arabic, French, Italian, Russian, and Urdu).
Evaluating the disparity in GPT-4's performance metrics when processing peer-reviewed academic literature compared to grey (non-peer-reviewed) literature.
